text:
Priya: FYI onboarding for cust-gamma's LoRA + 4-bit quant merge is failing a couple quick evals in the pack (cust-gamma-evalpack-v2).
Sam: ok which tests are red?
Priya: structured-output tests and a QA accuracy drop on short-context prompts. Quick paste of the summary below.
Priya: ```
> eval_pack: cust-gamma-evalpack-v2
> model: base-omega + gamma-lora.pt (merged)
> quant: 4bit-ptq
> tests: structured-json, qa-short, latency
> results:
>   structured-json: 62% pass (baseline 92%)
>   qa-short: 74% acc (baseline 87%)
>   latency: +6ms p50 (within budget)
> notes: tokenization mismatch seen in structured-json outputs; some fields truncated
```
Maria: tokenization mismatch + truncation sounds like KV cache or dequant rounding. Did merge use the patched merge script (preserves int8/4bit params) or the naive concat method?
Priya: we used the standard merge script from infra-lab, not the new quant-aware merge. I flagged that in the merge PR but wanted quick smoke.
Sam: can you attach one failing example? Even one input + output helps triage.
Priya: pasted one failing example below.
Priya: ```
INPUT:
{"id": 1234, "prompt": "Extract metadata from invoice: \nInvoice # INV-4242\nDate: 2025-11-03\nAmounts..."}
OUTPUT (merged+4bit):
{"invoice_number":"INV-4","date":"2025-11-","total":null}
EXPECTED:
{"invoice_number":"INV-4242","date":"2025-11-03","total":"$1,234.00"}
```
Jonathan: looks like tokenization shifted: digits truncated. That often happens when quantization changes logits for numeric tokens near EOS. Also merging LoRA into 4-bit weights without proper rescaling can amplify the issue.
Sam: EVA-bot, run the compat-ci check for this branch (cust/gamma/merge-quant).
eva-bot: @Sam compat-ci started on cust/gamma/merge-quant — running evalpack cust-gamma-evalpack-v2, will post results here. :gear:
Sam: in parallel, let's revert the merge on the branch and do a quant-aware merge with the new script that rescales LoRA deltas. Priya, can you re-run with that?
Priya: on it. I'll run merge-with-rescale, then rerun the quickpack and post results. ETA ~30m.
Maria: add CI check to block merges into quantized branches unless compat-ci passes structured-json & qa-short. We shouldn't rely on human smoke only.
Jonathan: agreed. Also add a small token-level diagnostic to the evalpack that prints tokenization/logit deltas for failing examples — that will speed future triage.
Priya: note for the run: I'll include KV-cache warmup and prefix-caching enabled to match production.
Sam: thanks. If rescaled merge fixes it we can add a post-merge job to run an expanded eval (50 examples) before promoting to prod.
Priya: update: rescaled merge + 4-bit rerun shows structured-json 90% and qa-short 86% — much closer. I'll push artifacts in ~10m. :thumbsup:
Sam: awesome. Once artifacts uploaded, create a short runbook entry in eng-ml/wiki about "LoRA merges into low-bit quant models" with do/don't.
Priya: will do. Closing the thread when artifacts are up.
